contract: Unchanged IDEA965 joint RAW + AUTHOR_SCOPE + SCOPE_FINALIZATION

definitions.J: Number of written ordinary ADD/MIX/FORBID instructions, including those inside false IF blocks.
definitions.M: Number of written material-word occurrences, including FORBID entries and occurrences in false IF blocks. This is not an executed spoon count.
definitions.b: Number of paid continued-word breaks. One break replaces one physical word by two fragments and adds two separate rrch markers.
definitions.C: Logical control tokens before word continuation.
definitions.V: Written vessel-name occurrences before word continuation.
definitions.P: All physical separated groups in the same complete messages.
definitions.Cp: Physical control tokens when the ordinary controls remain whole.
definitions.S8: Token total of the eight most frequent exact physical group forms in that same complete population, or all forms if fewer than eight occur.

identities: Substitution yields P=M+(3/2)Cp-(1/2)E exactly; continuation cancels from this identity.
necessary_bounds: There are at most eight fixed whole control forms, including rrch, so S8>=Cp. Additional noncontrol fragments equal to these forms can only increase their observed frequencies.
For J>0, J<=Cp/2. Since M>=0, M/J>=2M/Cp=(2P+E)/Cp-3 >= (2P+E)/S8-3.
Dropping the nonnegative E/S8 term gives the weaker bound M/J>=2P/S8-3. A negative lower bound supplies no useful positive minimum.
essential_scope: The population must contain complete messages with all controls, names, materials and continuation groups included. A cropped paragraph, strict-interior packet or selected group subset need not satisfy the identities.

Whole fixed control forms are a substantive premise for Cp and the eight-type bound. If ordinary instruction controls were themselves split by a physical continuation, their logical occurrences would no longer all appear as whole physical control tokens; the stated counting argument would require a separately declared treatment. No such treatment or contract modification is introduced here.
The same fixed surface spellings, or one global bijective renaming preserving them, must be used. Free contextual aliases for controls are outside this bound.

Guards affect execution, not written costs. False IF instructions and bans remain in J,M,B and V. Repeated FORBID entries are noncanonical under the source contract; the bound nevertheless counts written material occurrences, not inferred chemical types or successful additions.
No source-message parse, native counter, observed Top8 value or empirical outcome was used in this proof review.
claim_ceiling: The algebra is valid conditionally. It is not a manuscript exclusion, a frequency PASS, a native control assignment or an estimate of actual doses. Root owns any subsequent selection and population binding.
